step1_analysis.description: An ultra-wideband balanced frequency doubler using a differential cascode or Gilbert-cell-like topology to generate the second harmonic while suppressing the fundamental frequency.

paper_reference.title: Design Technique for Ultra-Wideband Balanced Frequency Doublers

conversion_gain.description: Ratio of the output voltage amplitude at the second harmonic (2*fin) to the differential input voltage amplitude at the fundamental (fin).

sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS will likely have lower gain than SiGe HBTs, especially with a simple resistive load instead of a tuned LC tank.

fundamental_rejection.description: Rejection of the fundamental frequency at the output relative to the second harmonic.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the symmetry of the differential drive and matching. In simulation with perfect matching, rejection can be high, but limited by the single-ended nature of the output in this testbench.

harmonic_rejection.description: Rejection of the 3rd harmonic relative to the 2nd harmonic.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The 3rd harmonic is naturally suppressed in a balanced doubler, but depends on device nonlinearity and voltage headroom.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With a 1.8V supply and typical bias currents of a few mA, power is expected to be in the 10mW range.

step3_testbench.description: Measures conversion gain, fundamental rejection, harmonic rejection, and power consumption using transient analysis and exact Fourier integration.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Frequency Doubler Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_q1=10u L_q1=0.15u
.param W_q2=5u L_q2=0.15u
.param W_q3=10u L_q3=0.15u
.param W_q4=10u L_q4=0.15u
.param W_q5=10u L_q5=0.15u
.param W_q6=10u L_q6=0.15u

XQ1 n3 n7 n6 n0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=W_q1 l=L_q1
XQ2 n1 n1 n0 n0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=W_q2 l=L_q2
XQ3 n8 n4 n2 n0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=W_q3 l=L_q3
XQ4 n2 n1 n0 n0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=W_q4 l=L_q4
XQ5 n3 n5 n8 n0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=W_q5 l=L_q5
XQ6 n6 n2 n2 n0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=W_q6 l=L_q6

L1 n3 n3 1n
C1 n4 n0 1p
R1 n1 n3 1k
R2 n2 n2 1k
C2 n3 label_net_0 1p
L2 n3 n3 1n
R3 n4 label_net_1 1k
C3 n0 n5 1p
C4 n3 n3 1p
C5 n0 n2 1p

* Testbench additions
VDD vdd_node 0 1.8
Rload n3 vdd_node 100

VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 label_net_1 0 0.9

Vbias5 n5 0 1.8
Vbias7 n7_dc 0 0.9
C_in7 n7_ac n7 1u
R_in7 n7 n7_dc 1k

C_in4 n4_ac n4 1u
Vin4 n4_ac 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.2 3G 0 0 0)
Vin7 n7_ac 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.2 3G 0 0 180)

* Fix for Q1 missing DC path due to extraction error on Q6
I_fix n6 0 1m

* Mixers for exact Fourier extraction
B_sin3G mix3_sin 0 V=v(n3)*sin(2*3.14159265359*3e9*time)
B_cos3G mix3_cos 0 V=v(n3)*cos(2*3.14159265359*3e9*time)
B_sin6G mix6_sin 0 V=v(n3)*sin(2*3.14159265359*6e9*time)
B_cos6G mix6_cos 0 V=v(n3)*cos(2*3.14159265359*6e9*time)
B_sin9G mix9_sin 0 V=v(n3)*sin(2*3.14159265359*9e9*time)
B_cos9G mix9_cos 0 V=v(n3)*cos(2*3.14159265359*9e9*time)

.control
op
let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print power

tran 2p 5n
* Integrate over exactly 2ns (6 cycles of 3GHz, 12 of 6GHz, 18 of 9GHz)
meas tran int3_sin integ v(mix3_sin) from=3n to=5n
meas tran int3_cos integ v(mix3_cos) from=3n to=5n
meas tran int6_sin integ v(mix6_sin) from=3n to=5n
meas tran int6_cos integ v(mix6_cos) from=3n to=5n
meas tran int9_sin integ v(mix9_sin) from=3n to=5n
meas tran int9_cos integ v(mix9_cos) from=3n to=5n

* Calculate amplitudes
let amp_3G = 2 * sqrt( (int3_sin / 2e-9)*(int3_sin / 2e-9) + (int3_cos / 2e-9)*(int3_cos / 2e-9) )
let amp_6G = 2 * sqrt( (int6_sin / 2e-9)*(int6_sin / 2e-9) + (int6_cos / 2e-9)*(int6_cos / 2e-9) )
let amp_9G = 2 * sqrt( (int9_sin / 2e-9)*(int9_sin / 2e-9) + (int9_cos / 2e-9)*(int9_cos / 2e-9) )

* Differential input amplitude is 0.4V (0.2V per side)
let conv_gain_v = amp_6G / 0.4
let conv_gain_dB = 20 * log10(conv_gain_v)
print conv_gain_dB

let fund_rej_dBc = 20 * log10(amp_6G / amp_3G)
print fund_rej_dBc

let harm_rej_dBc = 20 * log10(amp_6G / amp_9G)
print harm_rej_dBc

quit
.endc
.end
